id: title:Gilbert09:stop sending unsupported query params to recurly gift cards

review.posthog_relevance: Recurly warehouse connector configuration and request parameter handling
review.reason: Adds a configuration field `supports_list_params` and a runtime check to distinguish Recurly endpoints that support query parameters. P1.F2.H2 introduces the configuration, while P1.F3.H3 adds a test asserting that the connector does not send query parameters for the `gift_cards` endpoint. This demonstrates a bounded, substantive improvement in connector behavior and request safety
review.uncertainty: The actual execution path preventing parameter sending is not shown, so the implementation of the runtime check is not verified, though the configuration and test support the intended behavior.
